# Reconciled audit summary

**Release:** 3.6.3 (3 November 2026). **Analytical baseline:** v3.5; recorded CSV sign-off 2 November 2026. Generated by `scripts/reporting_support.py`.

## Scope and provenance limits

This report summarizes the five canonical Stage 3 CSVs. Normalized Stage 1/2 registers and reviewer rows are now supplied in screening/; screening flow and agreement are recomputed in results/screening_audit.md. Human-review identities, primary PDF contents, and the complete four-platform raw search yield are not independently authenticated. A recorded APPROVED_FINAL string is preserved data, not a new sign-off for this editorial revision.

## Adjudication: decisions versus affected rows

220 unique decisions = 86 RQ3 (25 BUG + 61 REC) + 123 RQ4 + 11 P3. The 86 RQ3 decisions affect 77 metric rows: 76 time rows with 85 decisions and one USD row (R12-E07-MET-081 / HUM-RQ3-BUG-025). Some rows have multiple decisions. The crosswalk mirrors time decisions and is not counted a second time.

The complete flattened decision-to-record register is `results/adjudication_register.csv`, derived from the original ID, action/disposition, rationale, locator, hash, and recorded sign-off columns. The internal 21-non-time-row description and REC-062..072 range are not part of this baseline.

## Reproducibility boundaries

`summary_tables.csv`, the three numerical reporting views, and the figures use canonical CSV aggregations. Figure 4d retains explicitly labeled reference-size constants in plotting code. Screening decisions, full-text exclusions, review rows, and arXiv occurrence/gate-pass provenance are supplied as normalized exports. Original XLSX files, primary PDFs, historical crosswalks, and the internal 107-candidate matrix are not distributed. Four arXiv expressions match the archived pipeline; ACM expressions are author-supplied with original UI settings unverified. NOT_DISCUSSED and Stage 0 are preserved historical codes and combined analytically as no demonstrated PQC migration.
